description: This file contains the implementation of the PdfWriter class, which is responsible for writing PDF objects, streams, and document structure to a PDF stream in the PDFsharp library. It includes methods for writing various PDF data types, managing object boundaries, and handling layout modes.

classes.name: PdfWriter
classes.description: A class responsible for generating and writing PDF streams, objects, and document structure within the PDFsharp library.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes the PDF writer, optionally closing the underlying stream.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Overloaded methods to write various data types (bool, int, long, uint, double, PdfString, PdfName, PdfLiteral, PdfRectangle, PdfReference, etc.) to the PDF stream.

methods.name: WriteBeginObject
methods.description: Begins writing a PDF object, handling placement and layout based on whether the object is indirect or direct.

methods.name: WriteEndObject
methods.description: Ends writing a PDF object, closing arrays and dictionaries, and handling indirect object termination.

methods.name: WriteStream
methods.description: Writes the stream associated with a PDF dictionary, optionally omitting the stream content.

methods.name: WriteRaw
methods.description: Writes raw strings, characters, or byte arrays directly into the PDF stream.

methods.name: WriteFileHeader
methods.description: Writes the PDF header, including version info and optional verbose comments.

methods.name: WriteEof
methods.description: Writes the end-of-file markers and optional verbose comments with document metadata.
